description:
Sit down with HB Studios’ VP of Engineering David McFarland as he digs into the complexities of making the 2K Games PGA TOUR series’ massive 2 km² photorealistic user-generated courses shareable across platforms.

title: Scaling user-generated content across platforms in PGA TOUR 2K25
